agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.5.1, back up local data with rer export --output exports/before-0.5.4.rer. For a hosted installation, export its D1 database with npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql using the original deploying Cloudflare credentials; DATABASE is recorded in .rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json. Keep the backup private. Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev; from a detached release tag use git fetch --tags && git checkout v0.5.4 instead of git pull --ff-only. For a hosted installation, update the original deploying checkout and run rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT with the same credentials. The update adds 11 migrations (0146-0156); retain all 60 migration files unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. The checkout pins rer 0.2.93 and installs it through the pinned tooling. Restore only into an empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.5.4.rer --yes, then check the owner, schedules, incidents and agent settings. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager active. Earlier upgrade instructions follow. From 0.4.2 or from the unreleased v0.5.0 tag, back up local data with rer export --output exports/before-0.5.1.rer. For a hosted installation, export its D1 database with npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql using the deploying CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; DATABASE is recorded in .rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json. Keep the backup private. Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev; from a checkout of the v0.5.0 tag run git fetch --tags && git checkout v0.5.1 instead of git pull --ff-only. For a hosted installation, run rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT from the original deploying checkout with the same credentials. From 0.4.2 the update applies 15 additive migrations (0129-0137, 0140-0145); from v0.5.0 it applies none. Keep all 49 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. Restore only into an empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.5.1.rer --yes, then check the owner, schedules and incidents. The application pins rer exactly to 0.2.71. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager active. Earlier upgrade instructions follow. From 0.4.2, back up local data with rer export --output exports/before-0.5.0.rer. For a hosted installation, export its D1 database with npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql using the deploying CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; DATABASE is recorded in .rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json. Keep the backup private. Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev; from the hosted checkout run git pull --ff-only then rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT with the same credentials. The update applies 15 additive migrations (0129-0137, 0140-0145); keep all 49 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. Restore only into an empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.5.0.rer --yes, then check the owner, schedules and incidents. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager active. Earlier upgrade instructions follow. From 0.4.1, back up first with rer export --output exports/before-0.4.2.rer (hosted: export the D1 database with npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql using the deploying Cloudflare credentials). Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev. For hosted installations, run git pull --ff-only and rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT from the original deploying checkout with the same credentials. The update applies one additive migration, 0128_import_door_archive.sql; keep all 34 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. A backup made by 0.4.1 restores into a fresh empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.4.2.rer --yes; credentials and sessions do not transfer, and receiving integrations stay inactive until locally authorized. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager. Earlier upgrade instructions follow. From 0.4.0, back up first with rer export --output exports/before-0.4.1.rer. Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev. For hosted installations, retain a verified hosted D1 export and private settings, then run git pull --ff-only and rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT from the original deploying checkout with the same credentials. Main also carries migration 0127 for installation-local signed-source credential custody; keep every applied migration byte unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. A backup made by the previous version now restores into a fresh empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.4.1.rer --yes. Restore retains authored records and import history; credentials and sessions do not transfer, and receiving integrations remain inactive until locally authorized. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager. Earlier upgrade instructions follow. To update from 0.3.0, back up first: locally with `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer`; for a hosted installation export its D1 database with `npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql` (the name is in `.rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json`) using the deploying Cloudflare credentials. Locally, stop `rer dev` with Ctrl-C, run `git pull --ff-only`, then `rer dev`. Hosted, from the checkout that deployed, run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT` with the same credentials; the owner, schedules and incidents are kept. The update applies ten additive migrations (0117-0126); keep all 32 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset to upgrade. Restore a backup only into an empty destination (`rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` locally, a fresh empty installation when hosted). Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. From 0.2.0, stop with `rer dev --stop` and `rer preview --stop`, then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. The update applies four additive migrations (0113–0116); keep all 22 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset to upgrade. Data, the owner and password accounts are kept. People who sign in with a workspace password sign in once more, because the held session cookie is now named `oncall_session_<port>`. Captured local sign-in mail is removed with the development outbox; open the app with the `RER_OPEN` link that `rer dev` prints. To update from 0.1.0, stop the old servers before pulling with `node scripts/rer.mjs dev --stop` and `node scripts/rer.mjs preview --stop`, install the global rer command with `curl -fsSL https://runeditrun.com/install.sh | sh` (or `npm install -g @runeditrun/rer`), then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. Back up first with `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer` (0.1.0: `node scripts/rer.mjs export --output exports/NAME.rer` while its servers are stopped). Restore only into an empty destination with `rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` after restoring the original private settings. For hosted coordination, follow Install and run → Host for your team: configure remote sign-in mail and run `rer deploy` with your Cloudflare credentials; rer claims the owner and retires the setup token. Open the app address and sign in by emailed link, or with `rer signin`. Update an existing hosted installation with `rer deploy`, preserving its owner and data. Remove with `rer deploy --remove --yes` and confirm its empty readback. Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. Independent standby and paging delivery are outside this release.
